priorityList: Cast Rake from Stealth to trigger Pouncing Strikes.
Cast Shred until you are at 5 Combo Points.
Cast Berserk & Tiger's Fury in the same GCD.
Cast Ferocious Bite with Apex Predator's Craving procs.
Cast Rip if it is missing on the target.
Cast Rip if it is in Pandemic and you have 5 Combo Points.
Cast Ferocious Bite if you have 4 or more Combo Points, 25 or greater energy, and Rip is active.
Berserk and Convoke the Spirits with Tiger's Fury, these should be synced.
Maintain Rake as it is a highly energy efficient spell.
Maintain Moonfire (if talented) as it is a highly energy efficient spell.
